title: Nonparametric Bayesian Policy Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.17068v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I propose Nonparametric Bayesian Policy Learning (NBPL) as a framework for uncertainty-aware treatment choice. The key observation is that welfare is fully determined by a reduced-form distribution, so uncertainty about optimal policies entirely reflects uncertainty about this distribution. NBPL places a Dirichlet process prior on the reduced-form distribution and uses the resulting posterior for both traditional policy choice and inference on optimal welfare and optimal treatment assignments. NBPL is computationally tractable: the default Bayesian-bootstrap implementation requires only exponential reweighting of the observations. I establish two theoretical properties. First, posterior welfare regret converges at the minimax-optimal rate, providing a novel policy-relevant analogue of posterior contraction rates. Second, posterior model selection across policy classes is consistent. I relate NBPL to existing policy learning approache

translated_title: 非参数贝叶斯策略学习
translated_abstract: 我提出非参数贝叶斯策略学习（NBPL）作为不确定性感知处理选择的一个框架。关键观察在于，福利完全由简化式分布决定，因此关于最优政策的不确定性完全反映了关于该分布的不确定性。NBPL在简化式分布上施加狄利克雷过程先验，并利用所得后验同时进行传统的政策选择以及关于最优福利和最优处理分配的推断。NBPL在计算上是易于处理的：默认的贝叶斯自助法实现只需对观测值进行指数重加权即可。我建立了两个理论性质。第一，后验福利遗憾以极小化极大最优速率收敛，这提供了后验收缩速率的一个新颖的与政策相关的类比。第二，跨政策类别的后验模型选择是一致的。我将NBPL与现有的政策学习方法联系起来。
tldr: 提出非参数贝叶斯策略学习（NBPL）框架，通过在简化式分布上施加狄利克雷过程先验实现不确定性感知的处理选择，并证明后验福利遗憾以极小化极大最优速率收敛、跨政策类别的模型选择具有一致性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Nonparametric Bayesian Policy Learning (NBPL), a framework for uncertainty-aware treatment choice that places a Dirichlet process prior on the reduced-form distribution, achieving minimax-optimal posterior welfare regret convergence and consistent posterior model selection across policy classes.
